card.name: All or each after premedication instructions
card.fires_on: The words "all" or "each" (rarely capitalized "All") right after premedicate, before, prior to, or for. They appear in dosing sections that say every patient or every infusion needs a pre-treatment or baseline test.

modes.label: Before each dose
modes.description: "each" or "all" after before/prior to, naming every infusion or dose that needs premedication.
modes.example: Premedication: dexamethasone 20 mg intravenously, 30 min before<< each>> infusion ( 2.3 )

modes.label: All patients
modes.description: "all" or "All" introducing every patient who must be premedicated or tested.
modes.example: obtain liver function tests (ALT, AST, alkaline phosphatase, and bilirubin) for<< all>> patients.

card.plain: It marks the words "all" and "each" in label instructions that apply to every patient or every dose.
